observational_design.primary_unit: one complete 400m2 plotID × eventID × boutNumber; nested within NEON site
observational_design.admissible_negative: protocol-qualified no focal taxon detection within completely observed 400m2 plot-bout; NOT regional absence
logic: All 16 required nested post-2019 subplots must have documentary sampling evidence; duplicates cannot substitute for missing subplots
Absent larger-subplot table, any plot lacking a complete 400m2 survey is UNRESOLVED, not negative
Use data-product aggregation logic of pinned NEONScience/neonPlants stackPlantPresence, never naive direct joins
Nested 1m2 detections propagate into 10m2 and 100m2; larger scales list newly encountered taxa only
Exact species identification or defensibly resolved current accepted concept required; sensitive taxon redactions and morphospecies codes unresolved
Multiple records for the same eventID and species may be duplicated; retain event-level unique detection
NEON survey non-detection and regional SDM occurrence are different spatial scales; external metric only tests relative plot-level detection ranking

required_before_claiming_independence: Reinspect exact original GBIF 2026-08-01 snapshot source records admitted to source-model likelihood after thinning and cross-mode deduplication
Compare datasetKey, occurrenceID/catalogNumber, event date and coordinates to NEON plot and voucher provenance; exclude or report any possible overlap
If source membership cannot be reconstructed with the identical frozen filtering, mark external independence unresolved
Evaluate temporal/spatial dependence even when datasetKey differs, including shared herbarium duplicate records
Do not refit the previously frozen held-out models and label the retrofitted result as the original confirmatory endpoint
